FB8014I.descriptionEn: Examines contemporary management theories and research, including Chinese and Western management practices, organizational knowledge, innovation, industrial strategy, and diversification. Students critically analyze management problems, compare management practices, and develop theory-informed research through seminars, case discussions, and assignments.
